title: Why Your Drains Gurgle When Emptying
description: A gurgling sound in your drainage system is a classic symptom of air pressure imbalances caused by restricted or improper venting. As wastewater rushes down a pipe, it acts like a piston, creating a vacuum behind it. If the plumbing vent is blocked or undersized, air cannot enter from the outside vent terminal. Consequently, the system pulls air through nearby fixture traps, siphonage breaks the liquid seal, and creates a distinct gurgling sound. Recognizing this issue helps plumbers diagnose venting restrictions before sewer gas enters the living space.

Why Your Drains Gurgle When Emptying

A gurgling sound in your drainage system is a classic symptom of air pressure imbalances caused by restricted or improper venting. As wastewater rushes down a pipe, it acts like a piston, creating a vacuum behind it. If the plumbing vent is blocked or undersized, air cannot enter from the outside vent terminal. Consequently, the system pulls air through nearby fixture traps, siphonage breaks the liquid seal, and creates a distinct gurgling sound. Recognizing this issue helps plumbers diagnose venting restrictions before sewer gas enters the living space.
